ITEM 1 | Irregular pieces of tan-brown, slightly browned meat-like chunks with a fibrous, grainy surface and some darker crisp edges, roughly 2-4 cm each, lightly glazed, sitting in the center-left of the plate with sauce bits around them | 150
ITEM 2 | Cooked dark green leafy greens, wilted and glossy, scattered among the chunks, with thin strands and small leaf pieces about 1-3 cm, slightly oily sheen | 30
ITEM 3 | Reddish-brown sauce or seasoning coating the pieces, with small flecks of red and green pepper bits and crumbs of tan granular texture scattered across the lower center of the plate, moist and clinging | 15
ITEM 4 | Single small dark brown rounded piece, about 2 cm, with a shiny glazed surface, sitting at the upper edge of the chunk pile | 10
ITEM 5 | Triangular slice of flatbread-style crust with golden-orange browned edges, topped with melted pale cream-white cheese in patches and a few darker brown toppings and small green flecks, about 10 cm long and 5 cm wide, slightly curled at the edges, placed on the upper right of the plate | 90
ITEM 6 | Small scattered crumbs and sauce drips of orange-red and tan color near the slice's base and on the plate surface, thin and sparse | 5
